folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B338: causal means, quiet lives and later defaults
folds.body:
All112 original lines were reviewed, including the bounded source table, result/mechanism/means distinction, substitutions, seven growth examples, passive-route table, traces, distributed competence and the prototype questions. Preserve the central authoring distinction: obtaining an outcome, understanding it, personally executing it, owning the tool and having present support are separate. These are useful questions rather than mandatory player meters or a universal minimum-stat formula. Commissioning can produce the real result without automatically conferring embodied mastery; an actual observation, instruction or supplied faculty can establish a different learning route.

The old one-realm/one-prestige caveat is superseded by October24 direction; it does not restrict the present broader vision or current Klein/Harry developer work. The timber comparison is an unselected example, not a new prerequisite or priority. The Skill, learning, power-model and discovery claims remain their original source slice, not a fresh audit of all current callers. Likewise Famine's unimplemented state is a dated observation; this read does not verify its present implementation. The recorded accepted passive-exposure direction excludes a universal requirement for exertion/clicks, while ordinary unfed play remains governed by its existing owner.

The progression table is a palette: practice, study and incubation need actual eligible conditions and time, not a universal played-time-only rule or automatic solved truth. Journey-wide eligible unused-time credit and selected world clocks are distinct from passive growth or automatic unattended production. Current AD52 permits supported compression and delegation without personal-first grinding. Someone directing, designing or reviewing can legitimately learn through that activity, while the worker's private embodied knowledge does not transfer automatically. Losing support changes the actual function supplied, not all acquired competence or every possible alternative.

Retain an actual known reason/alternative where available, without revealing hidden means or a universal faculty catalogue. An expert can generalize through a real principle; a fitting powerful method may bypass all old dependencies. M6's need for an authored exception is not a requirement to manufacture an interruption in every routine. Accessible saves, pause and detail controls do not consume fictional character capacity. AD51 favors one useful justified shared seam, followed by another world's validation, without prebuilding every capability model. No source, ability, XP, passive route, prototype or persistence behavior was implemented or verified here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B338: causal means, quiet lives and later defaults
folds.body:
All121 original lines were reviewed, including five complete interaction proposals and the connected inventor experiment. Preserve success changing a real opportunity, NPC purposes independent of regard, imperfect but continuing histories, quiet settled lives and delegated repetition with actual consequences. The bounded review never established novelty or absence elsewhere. Its linked audit leaves are not reread by implication, and writing the five joins does not establish current source or gameplay support.

DSI1's opening question does not require stopping a successful method from remaining best. A solved need may stay solved; teaching can create actual new opportunities without a mandatory scarcity, imitation, enemy scaling or resource drain to replace the old chore. DSI2's refusal is a useful specific-person scene, not a required refusal at maximum trust or a limit on a supernatural mechanism that truly creates trust, belief or allegiance. Where a power only compels behavior, do not fabricate affection; where it genuinely changes more, model that source honestly. Legible reasons concern available evidence, not mandatory disclosure of private motives.

An office, apprenticeship or repaired relationship retains its actual duties/history. Some failures yield opportunities; others need not be disguised rewards. A quiet chapter can continue without invented danger, prestige, rewards or a forced ending. A retained presence after perspective change needs the real clock, activity policy and support; a history entry cannot auto-create achievements. The old paused-world/active-crafting disclaimer records that pass's scope, not a live dispatch or current world order.

DSI5's selected exception and safe defaults fit later AD52, but not every unusual result must stop if standing instructions already resolve it. A shipment can settle partial progress and real costs; a new contract needs the actual allowed decision-maker rather than every choice returning to the player. Reports remain known/estimated/unresolved according to actual observation and communication. Current AD51 supports the first useful consumer rather than a general NPC scheduler or all-five-joins prerequisite. These ideas remain independently selectable, with generic human review optional under AD42 and actual native/persistence evidence still scoped to a future implementation.
